body.label: Effect
body.html: Enter a sensory trance until your next turn. You can perceive creatures and movement through ordinary visual obstruction within 3 units.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the next Action that targets you before your next turn.
Remove one Physical damage Condition from yourself.

rider.title: TRANCE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, increase the Trance's perception range by 2 units.
